body: Producer lesson (Termal::Opus2, 2026-10-11, from w-4cdbaeb1d27b's handoff). In a package note for Termal::Merger, give the ENGRAM SCHEMA-1 review-freeze fingerprint (what the termal_review_freeze_check tool and the Merger recompute), plus the staged blob ids (`git ls-files -s <paths>`). Never give only the launcher composite: captureFingerprint() in scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs is the launcher's input fingerprint, a different kind. Quoting it alone made the Merger stop before renaming the root, because its schema-1 recompute differed (a2be1050 vs my composite b22eed66) although the tree was identical (blob edb2bee5). Label every fingerprint with its kind.
